description: The ETFIQ benchmarks: published, rules-based yardsticks for model portfolios, each a written rule over broad, low-cost ETFs, grouped in families (strategic, tax-aware, factor, income, tactical, thematic) by stock share. Filter by family, or by band (a name such as moderate, a stock share such as 60, or "all stocks"). Use when asked which benchmark measures a kind of model portfolio, then get_benchmark for one. These are not a single fund's own benchmark: that is in etf_profile (benchmark), and how it is chosen is in etfiq_methodology. A benchmark is identical for everyone and never a recommendation: a request to customise one or to say what to buy is refused, and a request to build a custom portfolio is for build_portfolio.

band.description: Optional: a stock-share band by id (conservative, moderately-conservative, moderate, moderately-aggressive, aggressive), all stocks, all bonds, or a stock share such as 60 or 60/40.

family.description: Optional: a benchmark family, by id or name. The answer names the families when this matches none.

name: list_benchmarks

as_of.description: Date of the newest number in the answer.

citation.description: A ready citation string with the as-of date and the page address.

data.description: The answer, or null when ETFIQ refuses (then error and reason say why).

disclaimer_required.description: True when the answer carries numbers that need the not-advice line.

error.description: Present only on a refusal: what ETFIQ does not publish.

provenance.description: Where each number came from: field, source, as_of, source_uri.

reason.description: Present only on a refusal: why, and what to change.

tried.description: Present only on a refusal: what was looked up.

warnings.description: Caveats to show with the answer.
